listings.d: MilTech RV is a husband-and-wife mobile RV service business serving the Greater Des Moines area. They diagnose and repair house systems including 12V and 120V electrical, RV A/C and furnace, slide-out and leveling systems, water heaters, plumbing, awnings and roof sealant. Service is mobile, coming to approved campgrounds, RV parks, residences and storage locations. They state that engine, transmission, drivetrain, collision and major structural work are outside their scope.
listings.spec: All MilTech RV services are mobile, non-structural repair, diagnostic, inspection and maintenance services. They list engine, transmission or drivetrain repair, collision or accident body repair, major structural reconstruction, full roof membrane replacement and major slide-room rebuilds as work they do not do.

coverage_quotes: Mobile RV diagnostics, repair, maintenance, tank cleaning and inspections throughout the Greater Des Moines area and surrounding communities.
evidence.type_quote: We provide mobile service at approved campgrounds, RV parks, resorts, residences, storage locations and other locations where mobile RV service is permitted.

listings.d: Family First Mobile RV, LLC provides mobile RV repair in Des Moines and Central Iowa, traveling to the customer's home, campsite or storage lot. They service RV air conditioners, furnaces, water heaters, refrigerators, stoves, levelers, steps, plumbing, electrical, generators and slides, and also offer winterization, de-winterization and new-owner orientation. They describe themselves as 100% mobile and as campers who understand RV owners' needs.
listings.spec: Services excluded: roof replacements, black tanks, residential refrigerators, engines, tires, axles and drivetrains, and most pop-up styles of campers.

coverage_quotes: We proudly serve the greater Des Moines campgrounds and communities (see map).
evidence.type_quote: We are 100% mobile and we travel to you!
evidence.emergency_quote: After-hours / emergency service calls may also be available based on technician availability.

listings.d: Reynolds Mobile RV is based in Marengo and serves RV owners across the Iowa Corridor, bringing the shop to the campsite, driveway, storage lot or roadside. The owner and lead technician, Caleb Reynolds, works on all RV types from Class A motorhomes to pop-ups and says a real person answers day or night. Work includes 12V and 120V electrical, air conditioning, roof repair and replacement, slide-outs, plumbing, furnace and heat, and for Class A coaches generator and chassis work. The business states it is a repair business, not a lead service.

coverage_quotes: Reynolds Mobile RV is based in Marengo and serves RV owners across the Iowa Corridor.
Generator and chassis work, house battery and inverter systems, slide-out motors and seals, roof reseal and re-roof, and full 12V/120V diagnostics.
evidence.type_quote: Campsite, driveway, roadside, storage lot. I bring the shop to you.

listings.d: Master Certified RV Services is a mobile RV repair business owned and operated by US Military Veteran Jim Pettry, serving Cedar Rapids and the surrounding area. Jim is a certified technician through the RV Technical Institute, the National RV Training Academy and the RVDA/RVIA. The business offers mobile repair for motorhomes, 5th wheels and travel trailers, covering roof leak repair, battery repair and replacement, air conditioning, water system maintenance, slide-out rooms, awnings, electrical repairs and water heaters.

coverage_quotes: Jim, your Certified technician, brings years of expertise directly to your RV's location, handling everything from roof leaks and batteries to air conditioning and water system repairs.
evidence.type_quote: Mobile Service, we come to you!

listings.d: Hawkeye Mobile RV Repair is based in Sioux City and serves the surrounding area within 50 miles. The technician is RVTAA certified and insured and has more than 30 years of maintenance experience. Services include mobile RV repairs, maintenance, winterization and de-winterization, and inspections performed at the customer's location so the RV does not have to be moved or towed.

coverage_quotes: We are based in Sioux City, IA and serve the surrounding area within 50 miles.
evidence.type_quote: Our expert technicians come directly to you, providing quick and reliable service to get your RV back on the road.
evidence.emergency_quote: Limited Emergency Services Available After Hours/Weekends/Holidays Depending On Availability.

listings.d: Welch's Mobile RV Repair is a locally owned mobile business in Central Iowa that brings on-site RV and travel trailer repairs to campgrounds, storage facilities, homes and roadsides. Their services cover power and electrical systems, seasonal maintenance, heating, cooling and plumbing, structural and mechanical items such as awnings, slide-outs, leveling jacks, brakes and bearings, and emergency repairs. Technicians are certified through the RV Technical Institute, and the business states it is fully licensed and insured.

coverage_quotes: Service Areas Within 50 Miles of Des Moines, Iowa
Whether you're at a campground, storage facility, or roadside, our expert team brings the repair shop to you, ensuring your RV is road-ready and safe for your next journey.
evidence.type_quote: Whether you're at a campground, storage facility, or roadside, our expert team brings the repair shop to you, ensuring your RV is road-ready and safe for your next journey.
evidence.emergency_quote: Emergency services may be available on the weekends, depending on technician availability.

listings.d: RightNow Mobile RV Services is a mobile RV repair business that serves its Iowa home base from April to October and works in the south during the winter months. The Iowa service area is Cedar Rapids, Iowa City, the Amanas and surrounding towns. The technician is a certified RVTAA technician who attended in-person training at the National RV Training Academy in Athens, Texas, and the business emphasizes fixing the RV on site rather than at a dealer.

coverage_quotes: From April-October we serve our home base in Iowa which is Cedar Rapids, Iowa City, Amanas, and surrounding towns.
evidence.type_quote: Get it fixed onsite.

listings.d: Knapp Mobile RV Services performs onsite RV repair and maintenance for motorhomes, 5th wheels and travel trailers, and offers night and weekend appointments. They come to the RV for an extensive springtime maintenance checkup and cover services such as air conditioner service, wheel bearing service, brake adjustment, axle alignment, roof inspection, prevention and repair, waste tank hydro jetting, water heater maintenance, window seals, refrigerator maintenance, safety checks and awning replacement.

coverage_quotes: Onsite RV Repair & Maintenance Services
evidence.type_quote: We will come to your RV and perform an extensive springtime maintenance checkup.

listings.d: Hahn's Mobile RV Service is a mobile RV repair, maintenance and inspection business located in Glenwood, Iowa. They bring certified RV technicians to the customer at a campground, home or storage lot. Services include RV repairs for appliances, plumbing and water systems, electrical issues, RV maintenance, winterization and de-winterization, and thorough RV inspections.

coverage_quotes: Your Partner for Reliable RV Solutions

listings.d: Raccoon Valley RV offers mobile RV repair in West Central Iowa, with fully mobile service and factory trained technicians. The business keeps life rolling right where the RV is parked and aims to get customers back to camping. It is based at 101 Third Street in Beaver, Iowa.

coverage_quotes: MOBILE RV REPAIR IN WEST CENTRAL IOWA
evidence.type_quote: FULLY MOBILE SERVICE

listings.d: That RV Guy Bill is a mobile RV repair business whose home location is Muscatine, Iowa. Bill is an experienced mobile RV technician and an ASE Certified Mechanic who became a certified RV Technician, specializing in a wide range of repair services from routine maintenance to complex issues and is also equipped to handle warranty work. The business also services the Quad Cities, Iowa City, Burlington and surrounding communities, with a mileage fee possible beyond 25 miles.
listings.spec: Home location is Muscatine, IA. Anything > 25 miles a mileage fee may apply.

coverage_quotes: Home location is Muscatine, IA. Anything > 25 miles a mileage fee may apply. Also servicing the following areas: Quad Cities, Iowa City, Burlington, and all surrounding communities.
evidence.type_quote: Bill is an experienced mobile RV technician with a long history as a skilled mechanic.

listings.d: Jones RV Inspections and Repair describes itself as the number one mobile RV service in Southeastern Iowa, offering on-site RV services. Beyond inspections for travel trailers, 5th wheels and Class A/C motorhomes with fluid analysis, the business performs general RV repairs including AC, furnace, water heater and absorption refrigerator repairs, and also offers RV cleaning. It states plainly which systems it does not work on.
listings.spec: We do not work on the following: RV Motors, RV Frames, RV Brakes, RV Bearing, RV Solar Systems, RV Generators

coverage_quotes: Your #1 Mobile RV services in Southeastern Iowa
evidence.type_quote: Your #1 Mobile RV services in Southeastern Iowa
evidence.emergency_quote: Emergency rates apply for After hours and weekends

listings.d: Good Life RV is an RV service and repair facility with locations in Bevington and Webster City, Iowa. The business advertises certified technicians and 40 bays across two locations, RVIA-certified technicians, and a body shop and detail bay on site. It handles body work, siding, roof repairs, slideout repairs and other major reconstructions in-house, and offers published seasonal inspection, HVAC, bearing and brake, holding tank and slide-out service packages.

coverage_quotes: Des Moines (Bevington) · Webster City
Come see our certified technicians and 40 bays across two locations.
evidence.type_quote: Come see our certified technicians and 40 bays across two locations.

listings.d: Cheyenne Camping Center runs an RV body shop in Walcott, Iowa, handling collision repair, custom body paint, restoration and insurance claims. Its 47,500 sq. ft. purpose-built facility sits on 17 acres just off I-80 and includes a 45 foot paint booth, and its technicians are factory trained to repair all makes and models of RVs. Body repair services include collision repair, storm and hail damage, fiberglass and FRP wall delamination repair, part fabrication, paint matching and roof maintenance and replacement.

coverage_quotes: Our 47,500 sq. ft. purpose-built facility is located on 17 acres just off I-80 at Walcott Iowa and includes a 45’ paint booth.
evidence.type_quote: Our body shop is designed to handle all of your collision repair, custom body paint, restoration and insurance claim needs.

listings.d: The McKee RV Service Center in Perry provides maintenance and repair service for every RV category, including gas and diesel motorhomes, fifth wheels, travel trailers and bunk over cab motorhomes. The business states it services RVs regardless of whether they were bought from its dealership or another dealer. Services include appliances, slide-outs, awnings, roofs, oil changes, filter replacement, brake inspection and repair, fluid checks and tire inspection, as well as electrical system repair and engine work.

coverage_quotes: We can provide expert service for every RV category, including gas motorhomes, diesel motorhomes, fifth wheels, travel trailers and bunk over cab motorhomes.
evidence.type_quote: When your motorhome needs service, visit the skilled service technicians at the McKee RV Service Center in Perry.

listings.d: ATC RV Center offers RV service and repair in Cedar Rapids, Iowa, and customers can bring the RV in or submit a service request. The business grew from a three-stall repair shop and today runs a full service auto and light duty repair shop, a heavy-duty truck and RV repair shop, a trailer and tanker repair shop, a collision center and a wash bay. Its service and parts center on 66th Avenue SW is open Monday to Friday from 7 AM to midnight with 24/7 emergency roadside assistance.

coverage_quotes: 941 66th Ave., S.W. Cedar Rapids, IA 52404
Mon-Fri: 7AM - Midnight 24/7 Emergency Roadside Assistance
evidence.type_quote: We have experts at RV service that are outfitted to help fix any issue that you might be having.

listings.d: Jasper's RV Center in Hazleton, Iowa, is an RV dealership with a team of RV technicians and a stocked parts and accessories line for motorhomes, fifth wheels and travel trailers. It offers roof repair, major RV appliance repairs, repair of damaged aluminum sidewalls, winterization and spring check-up services. The business says it is conveniently located near Waterloo, Cedar Rapids and Dubuque, Iowa.

coverage_quotes: We are conveniently located near Waterloo, Cedar Rapids, and Dubuque, IA.
evidence.type_quote: As Iowa’s premier RV dealership, we’re committed to earning your trust.

listings.d: Ketelsen RV has a fully equipped service department for general coach work, bodywork, hitches and wiring, accessory add-ons, detail and reconditioning. Technicians serve customers year round in twelve enclosed, oversized service bays. The business lists Iowa service locations in Hiawatha, Elk Run Heights, De Soto and DeWitt.

coverage_quotes: Our friendly and experienced technicians are here to serve you year round in twelve enclosed, oversized service bays
evidence.type_quote: Ketelsen RV has a fully equipped Service Department for general coach work, bodywork, hitches and wiring, accessory add-ons, detail and reconditioning, and more.

listings.d: Lichtsinn RV operates an RV service department in Forest City, Iowa, with factory trained RVTI certified technicians who service motorhomes, travel trailers and fifth wheels. The dealership says it has recently expanded its service department to handle more service needs. It is located at 505 Highway 9 East in Forest City.

coverage_quotes: Lichtsinn RV 505 Highway 9 East Forest City, IA 50436
evidence.type_quote: We have Factory Trained RVTI Certified Technicians to service your motorhome, travel trailer or fifth wheel.

listings.d: Couler Valley RV is a family owned Dubuque, Iowa dealership in business for more than 35 years that takes care of RV service needs in a first class facility. It can accommodate problems with travel trailers, fifth wheels, folding campers, truck campers and motorhomes, from the smallest problem to a complete new roof. It honors all warranty work for the RVs it sells and provides insurance estimates at no charge.

coverage_quotes: We have been in business for 35+ years and can accommodate all types of problems that may come up with your travel trailer, fifth wheel, folding camper, truck camper or motorhome, from the smallest problem to a complete new roof we will be able to service your needs.
evidence.type_quote: Your RV service needs will be taken care of here at Couler Valley RV in a first class facility.

listings.d: Smith's RV runs a service department in Okoboji, Iowa, staffed with highly trained technicians who work on motorhomes and trailers. The business says its team of master technicians are factory trained and certified, handling regularly scheduled maintenance as well as full customization. It provides quality service to the entire Iowa Great Lakes Area and is located at 1000 Lake Shore Drive in Okoboji.

coverage_quotes: Smith's RV is proud to provide quality service to the entire Iowa Great Lakes Area.
evidence.type_quote: Our service department is staffed with highly trained technicians dedicated to making sure your motorhome and trailer stays in great working order for years to come.

listings.d: Bob's RV Repair is run by Bob Schroder, who has been repairing RVs for almost 20 years after starting with a large northwest Iowa RV dealership in 1990. Since 2016 he has operated his own business, providing RV repair at reasonable prices. The shop is located at 1858 Highway 59 in Sibley, Iowa, and is open seven days a week from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.

coverage_quotes: Our Location — 1858 Highway 59 Sibley, IA 51249
evidence.type_quote: Bob has been repairing RVs for almost 20 years.

listings.d: Ames Hydraulics is a mechanical, hydraulic and welding shop in Ames, Iowa that handles the mechanical side of RV and camper repair rather than dealer sales. Its RV work covers hydraulic leveling systems, slide-out repair, aluminum welding and frame repair, onboard generator repair, pumps and hoses, and trailer axle and running gear work. Owners from Ames, Des Moines, Ankeny, Boone, Nevada, Story City, Marshalltown, Fort Dodge and Cedar Falls can drop a camper at the shop on Highway 30 just off I-35.
listings.spec: No full-time RV tech services (roof re-seal, sidewall delamination, cabinetry, upholstery, awnings, plumbing fixtures, propane appliance repair) and no 12V/inverter/converter/solar wiring troubleshooting.

coverage_quotes: Owners searching for RV repair near me in central Iowa — Ames, Des Moines, Ankeny, Boone, Nevada, Story City, Marshalltown, Fort Dodge, Cedar Falls — can drop a camper here on the same lot that handles our trailer and hydraulic work.
evidence.type_quote: Ames Hydraulics is a mechanical, hydraulic, and welding shop, and it turns out that’s exactly what most RV repair jobs actually need.

listings.d: Campers Inn RV of Davenport offers complete RV service and maintenance capabilities in Davenport, Iowa. Its RVDA-RVIA certified technicians are trained to perform the full range of RV service needs including roofs, brakes, inspections, warranty work, and wheel and tire maintenance. The service list covers gas, diesel and generator oil changes, axle bearing packs, rubber roof maintenance, winterization, RV orientation, and system and appliance checks.

coverage_quotes: Our RVDA-RVIA certified technicians are trained to perform the full range of RV service needs, including roofs, brakes, inspections, warranty work, wheel and tire maintenance and more.
evidence.type_quote: Campers Inn RV of Davenport offers complete RV service and maintenance capabilities.

listings.d: Camping World's Davenport, Iowa location provides complete service and repair for all RV types, including diagnostics, repairs, routine maintenance and warranty work. The service location handles OE and extended warranty repairs and offers maintenance services such as oil and fluid changes, lube, and winterization and de-winterization. Amenities at the location include a collision center, appliance service, propane/LP gas, parts and accessories, and free 22-point inspections and collision estimates.

coverage_quotes: Davenport, IA 52804-9515
evidence.type_quote: We provide complete service and repair for all RV types.

listings.d: Lazydays RV of Council Bluffs operates an RV body shop handling body, collision and paint repairs, servicing all motorhome and trailer RV brands regardless of the purchase point. Capabilities include 60-foot paint booths, body and collision repair, fiberglass repair and metalwork, part fabrication, roof repair and replacement, paint matching, and Diamond Shield and decal replacement. The shop accepts most RV insurance and takes both waiting-on-site and drop-off appointments.

coverage_quotes: Nestled in Council Bluffs, our RV collision repair specialists are equipped with the requisite knowledge, tools, and facilities, converging to offer you a seamless, one-stop repair experience.
evidence.type_quote: Discover the zenith of body, collision, and paint repairs at Lazydays RV of Council Bluffs.

listings.d: Blue Compass RV Des Moines is an RV service center at 1400 Northridge Circle in Altoona, Iowa, open Monday through Saturday from 8am to 5pm. Certified technicians handle the full range, from de-winterization and roof seal checks to complex electrical and plumbing repairs, and every RV gets a free multi-point inspection. The service list includes chassis service, engine and transmission diagnostics and repairs, brakes, suspension, generators, slide-outs, roof repairs and collision repair and body work.

coverage_quotes: 1400 Northridge Circle, Altoona, IA 50009
Expert diagnostics and repairs for all RV engine types and transmission systems.
evidence.type_quote: Every RV that comes through gets a free multi-point inspection so nothing gets overlooked before it heads back out on the road.

listings.d: Jeff's RV is a local RV repair, service and parts business serving Cedar Rapids, Marion and nearby areas of eastern Iowa, with over 30 years of hands-on experience. It works on all makes and models including fifth wheels, travel trailers and motor homes, and will also travel to provide on-site service to select areas of eastern Iowa. It is a full RV service and repair center that will work with most major insurance companies to provide estimates and repairs.

coverage_quotes: Local RV Repair, Service & Parts Serving Cedar Rapids, Marion & Nearby Areas
evidence.type_quote: Jeff's RV is also willing to travel and provide on-site service to select areas of eastern Iowa.

listings.d: Bowling RVs provides RV service and mobile repair from Ottumwa, Iowa, with certified technicians who work on motorhomes and travel trailers and offer both in-house and mobile service options. The Ottumwa-based service center handles routine maintenance, complex repairs, electrical diagnostics, roof inspections, oil changes, brake inspection and generator service. The mobile service unit comes to the customer's home, campground, storage lot or lake site for air conditioning and furnace repairs, water heater troubleshooting, plumbing and electrical issues, slide-out and awning repairs, de-winterization and preventive maintenance.

coverage_quotes: Our Ottumwa-based service center offers a full range of RV repair and maintenance solutions.
Our team has over 66 years of experience serving RVers in Southeast Iowa, with trusted workmanship that’s warrantied and guaranteed.
evidence.type_quote: At Bowling RVs, we're committed to keeping your RV in top condition - whether you bring it to us or we come to you.

listings.d: Buscher Bros RV is a family-owned RV dealership in Algona, Iowa, in business since 1955. Its parts and service department handles RV repairs and has added a mobile RV repair van stocked with parts and tools to complete most common repairs at the campsite. The dealership sells travel trailers, fifth wheels, destination trailers and toy haulers.

evidence.type_quote: Recently expanded Services include our new Mobile RV Repair Van fully stocked with parts and tool to get most common repairs done right at the Campsite.

listings.d: Southwest Wholesale RV is an RV dealer in Sheldon, Iowa, with a service department that repairs RVs and campers of all types. Customers can call or text, submit an online form describing the problem, or bring the RV in for the shop to inspect. It is open Monday to Friday with Saturday morning hours.

evidence.type_quote: If you need some work done on your RV, we at Southwest Wholesale RV are able to help get it back into working order so you can get back on the road.
coverage_quotes: RV Service in Sheldon, Iowa

listings.d: Tri State Mobile RV Repair LLC is a mobile RV repair and inspection service based in George, Iowa, that travels to the customer. It serves residents of Sioux Falls and the Iowa Great Lakes area with a certified and insured technician and inspector, handling minor maintenance through more intricate repairs and mobile RV inspections. It emphasizes quality workmanship, honesty, integrity and transparency.

evidence.type_quote: By choosing Tri State Mobile RV Repair, residents of Sioux Falls and the Iowa Great Lakes area can rely on our Certified and Insured Technician and Inspector to efficiently handle a range of repairs, including mobile RV inspections.
coverage_quotes: At Tri State Mobile RV Repair, our vision is to become the top choice for mobile RV repair services and mobile RV inspections in the Sioux Falls area.
